newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine grain harvest at 21.03 mln T - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine grain harvest at 21.03 mln T - ministry.

text.p: Ukraine has harvested 21.032 million tonnes of grain so far this year, down from 28.958 million tonnes at the same time last year, a senior Agriculture Ministry official said on Wednesday.
Crop yields were lower at 2.10 tonnes per hectare, compared to 2.60 at the same period last year, Valentyn Tymoshenko told Reuters.
Ukraine's winter wheat harvest is nearly over and stood at 13.146 million tonnes, down from 15.587 million tonnes at this point in 1995, Tymoshenko added.
Deputy Prime Minister Mykhailo Zubets predicted last week a total grain harvest of 28 million tonnes this year - down from last year's 36.5 million tonnes and the lowest since the late 1940s.
Zubets also said Ukraine's winter wheat harvest would be at 14 million tonnes after 16.4 million tonnes in 1995.
The government predicts Ukrainian grain exports to neighbouring countries this year would be three million tonnes.
